BlockNumberOrTag.title: blockNumberOrTag
BlockNumberOrTag.description:
A block, given as its height in hex or as a tag. A height in decimal is rejected: the block is looked up by `Web3InformationRetriever`, which parses the number as hex and requires the `0x` prefix.

A 32-byte block hash is also accepted in this position and resolves to that block: a string of `0x` and exactly 64 hex digits is always read as a hash, never as a height, so a height zero-padded to that length is not accepted. It is deliberately left out of the union above, as publishing it would make it breaking to narrow. Look a block up by hash through the block reference object instead.
